section_html:
French Minor

A French minor will consist of six hours beyond the 12 hours B.A. foreign language requirement selected in consultation with a faculty advisor. The additional six hours must be at or above the 3000-level, with at least one of the courses at the 4000-level.

German Minor

A German minor will consist of six hours beyond the 12 hours B.A. foreign language requirement selected in consultation with a faculty advisor. The additional six hours must be at or above the 3000-level, with at least one of the courses at the 4000-level.
